Class BuildingCard

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsoft.mesos.server.model.game.cards.Card
it.polimi.ingsoft.mesos.server.model.game.cards.BuildingCard
All Implemented Interfaces:
CardAction
Direct Known Subclasses:
BigPpReward, CavePaintingBonus, HunterBonus, MultiplierForType, PairOfInventor, PrestigePointsForSet, SetForFood, ShamanStarsBonus, SustenanceDiscount
public class BuildingCard extends Card
Base abstraction for every building card.

A building card has a purchase cost, grants prestige points at the end of the game, and identifies its gameplay effect through a BenefitType.

    • applyEffect

      public void applyEffect(Player player)
      Applies the runtime effect of the building to the owning player.

      The base implementation is intentionally empty because some buildings only contribute static prestige points or override other hooks instead of running an immediate effect.

      Parameters:
      player - owner of the building
